answer: Everesse skin tightening is a non-invasive radiofrequency treatment that heats deeper skin layers to firm and lift the face, neck, jawline and body. It suits you if you're noticing loosening skin and want a no-needle option. Sessions take 30–60 minutes with no downtime, you'll see some tightening right away, and results build over 6 months.
treats_intro: Skin tightening treats loose skin on the face and neck, a softening jawline and the delicate under-eye area. It can also firm body areas such as the knees and abdomen.
how_h2: How does Everesse skin tightening work?
how: Everesse (VOLNEWMER), FDA-cleared in April 2024, is a radiofrequency device, not a laser. It sends RF energy into the deeper layers of your skin while continuous cooling protects the surface and keeps you comfortable. The heat makes existing collagen fibers contract, which is why you see some tightening right after treatment. It also signals your skin to build new collagen, so firmness keeps improving over the following months.
fit_h2: Is skin tightening right for me?
good_fit: You're noticing early loosening on your face, neck or jawline
You'd like gentle firming around your eyes
You want to firm body areas such as the knees or abdomen
You want a no-needle, no-downtime treatment
not_fit: You have a pacemaker or another implanted electronic device
You have significant metal implants in the treatment area
Your main concern is sun damage, fine lines or acne scars on the surface — laser skin revitalization is usually the better fit

faq_add.q: How many skin tightening sessions do I need?
faq_add.a: Most treatment plans call for 2 Everesse sessions about 6 months apart. Your provider will confirm the right plan for your treatment areas and goals at your consultation.

faq_add.q: How long do skin tightening results last?
faq_add.a: You'll see some tightening right away, and results keep building over about 6 months as new collagen forms. How long they last depends on your age, skin and lifestyle, since your skin keeps aging. Your provider can suggest maintenance. Results vary.

faq_add.q: Skin tightening vs. Radiant Lift: what's the difference?
faq_add.a: Everesse skin tightening is radiofrequency on its own, with no downtime, for the face, neck and body areas like the knees and abdomen. Radiant Lift pairs Everesse with a CoolPeel CO2 laser in the same visit to also refresh tone and texture, with 24–72 hours of redness. We'll help you choose based on your goals and budget.
